task_definition.task_name: Estimate Magnitude of Completeness using b-value Stability

task_description.overview: Estimate the magnitude of completeness (Mc) by identifying the lowest magnitude above which the b-value of the Gutenberg-Richter relation remains stable within its theoretical standard deviation.
steps: Load the earthquake catalog containing event magnitudes.
Set the magnitude bin width (Δm) and stability range L (default 0.5).
For each candidate Mc, compute b-values for magnitudes ≥ Mc and within the range Mc to Mc+L.
Calculate the difference between the aggregated b-value and the b-value at Mc.
Compare the difference to the theoretical standard deviation σ_b at Mc.
Select the smallest Mc where the difference is less than σ_b.
Return the estimated Mc and diagnostic information (magnitude tests, b-value differences).

task_definition.agent_prompt:
Estimate the magnitude of completeness (Mc) by the b-value stability method. Loading the earthquake catalog at {catalog_path}, bin the magnitudes with bin width {delta_m}, and apply the b-value stability method to estimate the magnitude of completeness Mc (`cat.estimate_mc_b_stability()`). Report the estimated Mc, plot a figure to show the magnitude of completeness (magnitude-frequency distribution). 
 Note: 1) The `seismostats` libarary is usefule for catalog statistic analysis and ploting. Please using or refer to the provided functions in `seismostats` 
 2) Save the mc data to {result_data.save name} with content {result_data.content} and the mc plot to {result_plot}.
